title: Software Engineering Intern - Summer 2025
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD program in Computer Science or related STEM field.
qualification: Proficiency in C++, Java, Python, or C#; strong foundational knowledge of data structures and algorithms.
description: Join Microsoft as a Software Engineering Intern to write scalable code, design robust systems, and build features for products used by millions worldwide.

title: Associate Frontend Developer
eligibility: Open to early-career developers worldwide with reliable internet access and matching time zone overlap.
qualification: 1+ years of experience working with JavaScript, Vue.js or React, HTML/CSS, and Git version control.
description: Work asynchronously in a 100% remote company developing key interface features for GitLab's web-based DevOps platform.

title: Chevening Fully Funded Master's Scholarship 2025
eligibility: Citizens of Chevening-eligible countries with at least two years (2,800 hours) of work experience.
salary: Fully Funded (Tuition, monthly stipend, flight allowance)
qualification: Undergraduate degree qualifying for a UK Master's program; strong leadership and networking capabilities.
description: Chevening Scholarships enable outstanding emerging leaders from around the world to pursue one-year master's degrees in the UK.

title: Data Analyst - Early Career
eligibility: 0-2 years of full-time work experience; recent graduates welcome.
qualification: Bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or CS; SQL proficiency.
description: Analyze complex supply chain metrics, generate actionable insights, and build interactive operational dashboards using SQL and Tableau.

title: Google Summer of Code 2025
eligibility: Open to students and open-source beginners age 18 and older.
qualification: Basic programming skills and familiarity with open-source collaboration platforms like GitHub.
description: A global, online program focused on bringing new contributors into open-source software development over a 12-week coding project.

title: CS50: Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to anyone globally; no prior programming experience required.
qualification: High school level mathematics and an interest in learning computational thinking.
description: An entry-level course teaching how to think algorithmically and solve problems efficiently using C, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
